syntax.passing_assertion: Every planned .py unit reaches indexed, parse_error or excluded with exact spans.
syntax.failure_rule: Any unit vanishes or a syntax error becomes empty success.
syntax.rationale: AST syntax and locations are independently testable.

imports.passing_assertion: Absolute, relative and alias imports match expected facts.
imports.failure_rule: Name-only guesses or stale removed imports fail.

exports.failure_rule: All declarations exported or listed export omitted fails.

names.passing_assertion: Three same functions retain distinct qualified identities.
names.failure_rule: Scope collision or file-only identity fails.

calls.passing_assertion: Exact, dataflow-bounded, ambiguous, unresolved and external calls keep their statuses.
calls.failure_rule: Text match promoted to resolved or unknown call omitted fails.
calls.rationale: Python AST alone cannot resolve all dynamic dispatch.

types.passing_assertion: Declared annotations and inheritance are emitted without compiler claims.
types.rationale: Fixture annotations support bounded facts only.

frameworks.failure_rule: Generic syntax success promoted to framework support fails.
frameworks.rationale: No named framework rule is frozen.

incremental.passing_assertion: Mutation forces stale/full rebuild and never claims incremental.
incremental.failure_rule: Silent stale reuse or incremental advertisement fails.
incremental.rationale: P1A freezes mutation truth, not an incremental implementation.
